caption: The drawing features a goat figurine standing on a green rectangular base. The goat has a woolly, textured coat depicted with varying shades of beige and light brown, along with white highlights. Its head is turned slightly to the right, showing one eye with a visible eyelid that has a pink outline. The nose and the interior of the ears are also colored in pink. The goat has two slightly curved horns and a distinctive black beard extending from its chin. The background of the drawing is plain, off-white, and unadorned, emphasizing the figure as the central and only object in the composition.
title: Goat
